title: Bolted Wood Connections — Structural Connections and Fasteners
body:

This record belongs to the Structural Connections and Fasteners database and covers bolted wood connections in full working detail: what it is, when it applies, how it is set out, and how it is checked. The database as a whole covers bolts, screws, nails, anchors, plates and structural connection design references.

Actual content. Bolted Wood Connections is executed as follows. First, confirm the building type, the project stage and the governing requirements for the jurisdiction, and record those decisions before any dimension or quantity is fixed. Second, lay out the work from the controlling dimensions, keeping clearances, tolerances and interfaces with adjoining work explicit rather than assumed. Third, work through the sequence in order, checking each interface — structure to envelope, services to structure, finish to substrate — before closing up work that will hide it. Fourth, record the as-built result, including any deviation from the plan and the reason for it, so the next trade and the next inspection can rely on the record. A complete bolted wood connections entry therefore carries its dimensions, its materials, its sequence, its tolerances and its check results, not a title alone.
